plugins.name: pyDAEDALUS — DX Wireframe Routing
plugins.description: Experimental: follows the original pyDAEDALUS routing, but no design made with this plugin has been folded yet. Check the result before ordering staples. Routes the active wireframe region's mesh with two-helix (DX) edges, B-form DNA and an M13 scaffold. Needs a closed mesh in an empty wireframe region, and rescales the mesh to the size of the design.
